### PREPARING DATA FOR CENSORED IMPUTATION----
```{r}
full_dataset <- full_dataset |>
  mutate(
    ldl_cens = case_when(
      !is.na(ldl_cholesterol) ~ "none",
      is.na(ldl_cholesterol)  ~ "interval",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
   ldl_ub = case_when(
      ldl_cens == "none" ~ ldl_cholesterol,
  
        ## LDL not calculated if total cholesterol <100 and/or bf(triglycerides < 50 and/or HDL <20
        ## and/or triglycerides >400
      # TC observed, HDL observed, trig observed (>400 case) -- just plugging in observed values
      ldl_cens == "interval" & !is.na(total_cholesterol) & !is.na(hdl_cholesterol) & !is.na(triglycerides) ~
        pmax(total_cholesterol - hdl_cholesterol - (triglycerides / 5), 1),

      # TC observed, HDL observed, trig missing (<50 case) -- use trig's own ub=50
      ldl_cens == "interval" & !is.na(total_cholesterol) & !is.na(hdl_cholesterol) &  is.na(triglycerides) ~
        pmax(total_cholesterol - hdl_cholesterol - (50 / 5), 1),

      # TC <100, HDL observed, trig observed -- fall back to TC LLOQ
      ldl_cens == "interval" &  is.na(total_cholesterol) & !is.na(hdl_cholesterol) & !is.na(triglycerides) ~
        pmax(100 - hdl_cholesterol - (triglycerides / 5), 1),

      # TC <100, HDL observed, trig <50 -- both substituted to LLOQ
      ldl_cens == "interval" &  is.na(total_cholesterol) & !is.na(hdl_cholesterol) &  is.na(triglycerides) ~
        pmax(100 - hdl_cholesterol - (50 / 5), 1),

      # TC < 100, HDL  < 20, triglycerides observed 
      ldl_cens == "interval" &  is.na(hdl_cholesterol) &  is.na(total_cholesterol) & !is.na(triglycerides) ~
        pmax(100 - 1 - (triglycerides/5), 1),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    ldl_lb = case_when(
      ldl_cens == "none"     ~ ldl_cholesterol,
      ldl_cens == "interval" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    ## Triglycerides (LLOQ = 50)
    tri_cens = case_when(
      !is.na(triglycerides) ~ "none",
      is.na(triglycerides)  ~ "interval",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    tri_lb = case_when(
      tri_cens == "none"     ~ triglycerides,
      tri_cens == "interval" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    tri_ub = case_when(
      tri_cens == "none"     ~ triglycerides,
      tri_cens == "interval" ~ 50,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    ## Total cholesterol (LLOQ = 100)
    tot_chol_cens = case_when(
      !is.na(total_cholesterol) ~ "none",
      is.na(total_cholesterol)  ~ "interval",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    tot_chol_lb = case_when(
      tot_chol_cens == "none"     ~ total_cholesterol,
      tot_chol_cens == "interval" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    tot_chol_ub = case_when(
      tot_chol_cens == "none"     ~ total_cholesterol,
      tot_chol_cens == "interval" ~ 100,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    ## HDL cholesterol (LLOQ = 20)
    hdl_cens = case_when(
      !is.na(hdl_cholesterol) ~ "none",
      is.na(hdl_cholesterol)  ~ "interval",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    hdl_lb = case_when(
      hdl_cens == "none"     ~ hdl_cholesterol,
      hdl_cens == "interval" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    hdl_ub = case_when(
      hdl_cens == "none"     ~ hdl_cholesterol,
      hdl_cens == "interval" ~ 20,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
  
```

## 1.5 Analytic dataset

```{r model_data}

model_data <- full_dataset |>
  mutate(
    log_BMI           = log(BMI),
    log_body_fat      = log(body_fat),
    market_food_index_raw = market_food_index,
    market_food_index = log(market_food_index + 1),
    log_MAP           = log(MAP),
    log_glucose       = log(glucose),
    log_hdl           = log(hdl_cholesterol),
    log_total_cholesterol = log(total_cholesterol),
    log_triglycerides = log(triglycerides),
    log_ldl           = log(ldl_cholesterol),
    log_crp           = log(crp),
    age_raw           = age,

    ## interval censored triglycerides, HDL, total cholesterol, and LDL
    ## NOTE: these are scaled manually below using a SHARED mean/sd per analyte,
    ## NOT via the generic across()/scale() block -- scaling lb/ub independently
    ## would not preserve lb < ub ordering, since each column would get a
    ## different mean/sd applied to it.
    log_ldl_lb = log(ldl_lb),
    log_ldl_ub = log(ldl_ub),

    log_tri_lb = log(tri_lb),
    log_tri_ub = log(tri_ub),

    log_tot_chol_lb = log(tot_chol_lb),
    log_tot_chol_ub = log(tot_chol_ub),

    log_hdl_lb = log(hdl_lb),
    log_hdl_ub = log(hdl_ub),
    cgsol_z = scale(cgsol),
    hsol_z = scale(hsol)
  ) |>
  mutate(across(c( market_food_index,
                  log_BMI,
                  log_body_fat,
                  log_MAP,
                  log_glucose,
                  log_crp,
                  log_hdl,
                  log_total_cholesterol,
                  log_ldl,
                  log_triglycerides,
                  age),
                ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)))) |>
  mutate(
    gender          = case_when(
      gender == "Male"   ~ 1L,
      gender == "Female" ~ 0L,
      TRUE               ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    food_insecurity = as.integer(food_insecurity),
    village         = as.character(village)
  )

scale_censored_pair <- function(data, lb_col, ub_col, cens_col, raw_observed_col) {
  log_mean <- data |>
    filter(.data[[cens_col]] == "none") |>
    mutate(tmp = log(.data[[raw_observed_col]])) |>
    pull(tmp) |>
    mean(na.rm = TRUE)

  log_sd <- data |>
    filter(.data[[cens_col]] == "none") |>
    mutate(tmp = log(.data[[raw_observed_col]])) |>
    pull(tmp) |>
    sd(na.rm = TRUE)

  new_lb_name <- paste0("log_", lb_col)
  new_ub_name <- paste0("log_", ub_col)

  data |>
    mutate(
      "{new_lb_name}" := (log(.data[[lb_col]]) - log_mean) / log_sd,
      "{new_ub_name}" := (log(.data[[ub_col]]) - log_mean) / log_sd
    )
}

model_data <- model_data |>
  scale_censored_pair("ldl_lb", "ldl_ub", "ldl_cens", "ldl_cholesterol") |>
  scale_censored_pair("tri_lb", "tri_ub", "tri_cens", "triglycerides") |>
  scale_censored_pair("hdl_lb", "hdl_ub", "hdl_cens", "hdl_cholesterol") |>
  scale_censored_pair("tot_chol_lb", "tot_chol_ub", "tot_chol_cens", "total_cholesterol")


# Missingness summary
model_data |>
  summarise(
    n_total_chol_missing    = sum(is.na(total_cholesterol)),
    n_ldl_missing           = sum(is.na(ldl_cholesterol)),
    n_hdl_missing           = sum(is.na(hdl_cholesterol)),
    n_triglycerides_missing = sum(is.na(triglycerides)),
    n_glucose_missing = sum(is.na(glucose)),
    n_map_missing = sum(is.na(MAP)),
    n_ffq_missing = sum(is.na(market_food_index)),
    n_bmi_missing = sum(is.na(BMI)),
    n_age_missing = sum(is.na(age)),
    n_gender_missing = sum(is.na(gender)),
    n_hsol_missing = sum(is.na(hsol_z)),
    n_cgsol_missing = sum(is.na(cgsol_z)))

## Ensuring none of the duplicate participants ended up in the model df
exclusive_id_pairs <- list(
  c("A123", "A414"),
  c("A175", "A387"),
  c("A181", "A360"),
  c("A188", "A382"),
  c("A222", "A307")
)

for (pair in exclusive_id_pairs) {
  in_data <- pair %in% model_data$participant_id
  if (all(in_data)) {
    cat("VIOLATION:", pair[1], "and", pair[2], "both present\n")
  } else if (!any(in_data)) {
    cat("neither present:", pair[1], "/", pair[2], "\n")
  } else {
    cat("OK - exactly one present:", pair[which(in_data)], "\n")
  }
}

print("FINAL ANALYTICAL SAMPLE SIZE:")
nrow(model_data)

model_data |> 
  count(hdl_cens)
model_data |> 
  count(ldl_cens)
model_data |> 
  count(tri_cens)
```

#### DEMOGRAPHICS TABLE
```{r demo_table}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Helper: mean (SD) string
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
mean_sd <- function(x) {
  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# Continuous variables
continuous_summary <- model_data %>%
  group_by(village) %>%
  summarise(
    `Age (years)`       = mean_sd(age_raw),
    `House Construction` = mean_sd(hsol),
    `Commercial Goods` = mean_sd(cgsol),
    `Market Food Index` = mean_sd(market_food_index_raw)) |>
  pivot_longer(-village, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value")

sex_summary <- model_data %>%
  group_by(village) %>%
  summarise(
    `Female (%)`   = sprintf("%d%% (n=%d)", round((1 - mean(gender, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100), sum(gender == 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `Male (%)`   = sprintf("%d%% (n=%d)", round((mean(gender, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100), sum(gender, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-village, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value")

n_row <- model_data %>%
  group_by(village) %>%
  summarise(Value = as.character(n()), Variable = "N") %>%
  select(Variable, everything())

table_all <- bind_rows(continuous_summary,sex_summary, n_row) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = village, values_from = Value) %>%
  relocate(Variable)

final_table <- table_all %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Descriptive statistics by village") %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Village") %>%
  sub_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "")

final_table |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_body(rows = Variable == "N"))
```

#### VALUES ABOVE CUTOFF
```{r biomarker_cutoffs}
model_data |>
  summarise(
    high_total_cholesterol_pct    = 100*sum((total_cholesterol>=200), na.rm = T)/ 393,
    high_ldl_cholesterol_pct    =  100*sum((ldl_cholesterol>=100), na.rm = T)/393,
    high_trig_pct    =  100*sum((triglycerides>=150), na.rm = T)/ 393,
    high_glucose_pct    =  100*sum((glucose>=100), na.rm = T)/ 393,
    htn_pct_who    =  100*sum((average_diastolic>=90|average_systolic>=140), na.rm = T)/ sum(!is.na(average_diastolic)&!is.na(average_systolic)),
    htn_pct_aha    =  100*sum((average_diastolic>=80|average_systolic>=130), na.rm = T)/ sum(!is.na(average_diastolic)&!is.na(average_systolic)),
    high_crp_pct    =  100*sum((crp>=3), na.rm = T)/ sum(!is.na(crp)),
    overweight_bmi_pct  =  100*sum((BMI>=25), na.rm = T)/ sum(!is.na(crp))
    ) 

cardiochek_stats <- model_data |>
mutate(
    high_total_cholesterol = ifelse(tot_chol_lb >= 200, 1L, 0L),
    high_ldl_cholesterol   = ifelse(ldl_lb >= 100, 1L, 0L),
    high_triglycerides     = ifelse(tri_lb >= 150, 1L, 0L),
    high_glucose           = ifelse(glucose >= 100, 1L, 0L),
    low_hdl_cholesterol    = case_when(
      gender == 1 & hdl_lb < 40 ~ 1L,
      gender == 0 & hdl_lb < 50 ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    ),
    high_waste_circumference    = case_when(
      gender == 1 & waist_circumference >= 102 ~ 1L,
      gender == 0 & waist_circumference >= 88 ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    high_cardiochek_binary = case_when(
      high_total_cholesterol == 1 | high_ldl_cholesterol == 1 |
        high_triglycerides == 1 | high_glucose == 1 ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    ),
    high_bp_for_mets = ifelse(average_systolic >= 130 | average_diastolic >= 85, 1L, 0L)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    metabolic_syndrome_score = rowSums(
      cbind(high_glucose, high_bp_for_mets, high_triglycerides, low_hdl_cholesterol, high_waste_circumference)
    ),
    metabolic_syndrome_binary = ifelse(metabolic_syndrome_score>=3, 1, 0)
  )

cat("Metabolic syndrome (full sample, N=381):", paste0(round(n_metabolic_syndrome * 100/381, 2), "%"), "(n =", n_metabolic_syndrome, ")\n")
```

# 3. Primary Path Model: cgsol_z → Diet → Cardiometabolic Outcomes

## 3.1 Model fitting

```{r path_model, cache=TRUE, message=FALSE}
# Village random intercepts on all equations.
priors_path <- c(
  ## -------------------------------------------------
  ## market_food_index (Gaussian)
  ## -------------------------------------------------
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = b,         resp = marketfoodindex),
  prior(normal(0, 2),   class = Intercept, resp = marketfoodindex),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = sd,        resp = marketfoodindex, group = village),
  prior(exponential(1), class = sigma,     resp = marketfoodindex),

  ## -------------------------------------------------
  ## log_BMI (Gaussian)
  ## -------------------------------------------------
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = b,         resp = logBMI),
  prior(normal(0, 2),   class = Intercept, resp = logBMI),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = sd,        resp = logBMI, group = village),
  prior(exponential(1), class = sigma,     resp = logBMI),

  ## -------------------------------------------------
  ## log_MAP (Gaussian)
  ## -------------------------------------------------
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = b,         resp = logMAP),
  prior(normal(0, 2),   class = Intercept, resp = logMAP),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = sd,        resp = logMAP, group = village),
  prior(exponential(1), class = sigma,     resp = logMAP),

  ## -------------------------------------------------
  ## Triglycerides 
  ## -------------------------------------------------
  prior(normal(0, 1),         class = b,         resp = logtrilb),
  prior(normal(0, 2),  class = Intercept, resp = logtrilb),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5),       class = sd,        resp = logtrilb, group = village),
  prior(exponential(1),       class = sigma,     resp = logtrilb),

  ## -------------------------------------------------
  ## log_Glucose (Gaussian)
  ## -------------------------------------------------
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = b,         resp = logglucose),
  prior(normal(0, 2),   class = Intercept, resp = logglucose),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = sd,        resp = logglucose, group = village),
  prior(exponential(1), class = sigma,     resp = logglucose),

  ## -------------------------------------------------
  ## LDL cholesterol 
  ## -------------------------------------------------
  prior(normal(0, 1),        class = b,         resp = logldllb),
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = Intercept, resp = logldllb),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5),      class = sd,        resp = logldllb, group = village),
  prior(exponential(1),      class = sigma,     resp = logldllb),

  ## -------------------------------------------------
  ## HDL cholesterol 
  ## -------------------------------------------------
  prior(normal(0, 1),        class = b,         resp = loghdllb),
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = Intercept, resp = loghdllb),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5),      class = sd,        resp = loghdllb, group = village),
  prior(exponential(1),      class = sigma,     resp = loghdllb),

  ## -------------------------------------------------
  ## Food insecurity (Bernoulli)
  ## -------------------------------------------------
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = b,         resp = foodinsecurity),
  prior(normal(0, 2),   class = Intercept, resp = foodinsecurity),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = sd,        resp = foodinsecurity, group = village)
)

set.seed(24)

fit_path <- readRDS(paste0(fits_dir, "fit_path_2026.08.11_cens.rds"))

# ── Summaries ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fixef(fit_path, probs = c(0.055, 0.945))

# ── Indirect effects via posterior draws ──────────────────────────────────────
# indirect effect of MI on each outcome through market food index
# = a-path draw × b-path draw

draws <- as_draws_df(fit_path)

# a-path: cgsol_z → market_food_index (substantive MI predictor)
a <- draws$b_marketfoodindex_cgsol_z

indirect_effects <- tibble(
  BMI        = a * draws$b_logBMI_market_food_index,
  MAP             = a * draws$b_logMAP_market_food_index,
  triglycerides   = a * draws$b_logtrilb_market_food_index,
  glucose         = a * draws$b_logglucose_market_food_index,
  LDL             = a * draws$b_logldllb_market_food_index,
  HDL             = a * draws$b_loghdllb_market_food_index,
  food_insecurity = a * draws$b_foodinsecurity_market_food_index)

# Summarise: median + 89% CI + directional posterior probability
indirect_summary <- indirect_effects |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "outcome", values_to = "indirect") |>
  group_by(outcome) |>
  summarise(
    median = median(indirect),
    q5.5   = quantile(indirect, 0.055),
    q94.5  = quantile(indirect, 0.945),
    # direction depends on outcome: positive = worse for biomarkers, negative = better for FI
    p_pos  = mean(indirect > 0),
    p_neg  = mean(indirect < 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(indirect_summary)

  BMI        =  draws$b_logBMI_cgsol_z,

  HDL             = draws$b_loghdllb_cgsol_z,
  food_insecurity = draws$b_foodinsecurity_cgsol_z)

# Summarise directional posterior probability

  summarise(
    p_pos  = mean(direct > 0),
    p_neg  = mean(direct < 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## TOTAL EFFECTS OF MI ON FOOD INSECURITY
direct_draws_fi   <- draws$b_foodinsecurity_cgsol_z
indirect_draws_fi <- a * draws$b_foodinsecurity_market_food_index   # a = draws$b_marketfoodindex_cgsol_z

total_draws_fi <- direct_draws_fi + indirect_draws_fi
```

```{r path_model_plots}
}
```

## 3.4 Censored data diagnostics

```{r primary_imputation_diagnostics}
log_trig_mean <- model_data |>
  filter(tri_cens == "none") |>
  pull(triglycerides) |>
  log() |>
  mean(na.rm = TRUE)

log_trig_sd <- model_data |>

  sd(na.rm = TRUE)

  pull(triglycerides) |> 
  median(triglycerides, na.rm = T)

  filter(ldl_cens == "none") |>
  pull(ldl_cholesterol) |>
  log() |>
  mean(na.rm = TRUE)

log_ldl_sd <- model_data |>
  filter(ldl_cens == "none") |>
  pull(ldl_cholesterol) |>
  log() |>
  sd(na.rm = TRUE)

observed_median_ldl <- full_dataset |>
  pull(ldl_cholesterol) |> 
  median(ldl_cholesterol, na.rm = T)

extract_censored_truncated <- function(fit, resp, cens_colname,
                                        lb_colname, ub_colname,
                                        log_mean, log_sd,
                                        source_data) {   # <- pass model_data explicitly
  fit_data <- fit$data
  cens_vec <- fit_data[[cens_colname]]
  cens_idx <- which(cens_vec != "none")

  mu_z_draws    <- posterior_linpred(fit, resp = resp, dpar = "mu")[, cens_idx]
  sigma_z_draws <- posterior_linpred(fit, resp = resp, dpar = "sigma")[, cens_idx]

  mu_draws    <- mu_z_draws * log_sd + log_mean
  sigma_draws <- sigma_z_draws * log_sd

  # pull bounds from source_data (model_data), not fit$data, and force numeric
  a <- as.numeric(source_data[[lb_colname]][cens_idx])
  b <- as.numeric(source_data[[ub_colname]][cens_idx])

  stopifnot(!anyNA(a), !anyNA(b))   # fail loudly if coercion produced NAs

  log_a <- log(a)
  log_b <- log(b)

  n_draws <- nrow(mu_draws)
  n_rows  <- length(cens_idx)
  trunc_mean <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_draws, ncol = n_rows)

  for (j in seq_len(n_rows)) {
    mu_j    <- mu_draws[, j]
    sigma_j <- sigma_draws[, j]
    alpha   <- (log_a[j] - mu_j) / sigma_j
    beta    <- (log_b[j] - mu_j) / sigma_j

    log_num <- log(pmax(pnorm(beta - sigma_j) - pnorm(alpha - sigma_j),
                         .Machine$double.xmin))
    log_den <- log(pmax(pnorm(beta) - pnorm(alpha), .Machine$double.xmin))

    trunc_mean[, j] <- exp(mu_j + (sigma_j^2) / 2 + log_num - log_den)
  }

  tibble(
    row_idx     = cens_idx,
    cens_type   = cens_vec[cens_idx],
    mu_log_med  = apply(mu_draws, 2, median),
    exp_mu_med  = exp(apply(mu_draws, 2, median)),
    value_raw   = apply(trunc_mean, 2, median),
    q5.5_raw    = apply(trunc_mean, 2, quantile, probs = 0.055),
    q94.5_raw   = apply(trunc_mean, 2, quantile, probs = 0.945)
  )
}

trig_censored <- extract_censored_truncated(
  fit_path, "logtrilb", "tri_cens", "tri_lb", "tri_ub",
  log_trig_mean, log_trig_sd, source_data = model_data
)

ldl_censored <- extract_censored_truncated(
  fit_path, "logldllb", "ldl_cens", "ldl_lb", "ldl_ub",
  log_ldl_mean, log_ldl_sd, source_data = model_data
)

cat("── Triglycerides (truncated conditional mean) ──\n")
cat("N censored:", nrow(trig_censored), "\n")
cat("Truncated fitted median (mg/dL):", round(median(trig_censored$value_raw), 1), "\n")
cat("Truncated fitted 89% CI:",
    round(quantile(trig_censored$value_raw, 0.055), 1), "–",
    round(quantile(trig_censored$value_raw, 0.945), 1), "mg/dL\n")
cat("Naive exp(mu) median (ignoring truncation):",
    round(median(trig_censored$exp_mu_med), 1), "mg/dL\n")
cat("Observed median:",
    round(median(observed_median_trig), 1), "mg/dL\n")

cat("── LDL cholesterol (truncated conditional mean) ──\n")
cat("N censored:", nrow(ldl_censored), "\n")
cat("Truncated fitted median (mg/dL):", round(median(ldl_censored$value_raw), 1), "\n")
cat("Truncated fitted 89% CI:",
    round(quantile(ldl_censored$value_raw, 0.055), 1), "–",
    round(quantile(ldl_censored$value_raw, 0.945), 1), "mg/dL\n")
cat("Naive exp(mu) median (ignoring truncation):",
    round(median(ldl_censored$exp_mu_med), 1), "mg/dL\n")
cat("Observed median:",
    round(median(observed_median_ldl), 1), "mg/dL\n")


```
